notes:
- Pause, resume, quit, and adjust audio from the game toolbar. In online matches, message your opponent or hide and reopen a call while playing.
- Resume Game in My Games opens the board directly. In-game chat slides down, and new messages briefly appear on the board while chat is closed.
- Chats now support inline audio, photo and video previews, reply reminders, and Trash. Settings adds Quiet Hours, encrypted Chatmail backups, and connection details.
- Adjust message text size in Appearance, and use the improved call answer layout and video self-view controls.
